adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, the function returns the Zod `safeParse` result wrapper (`{ success, data, error }`), not the parsed `data`. However, in `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` the refreshed credential key is set as `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then persisted via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`. That would store the wrapper object as the credential `key` instead of the expected credential payload, corrupting stored credentials. (By contrast, Office365/Salesforce use `.success`/`.data` from the returned wrapper, indicating GoogleCalendarService is inconsistent.)
